## About Me

I am a Wesleyan University senior investigating the relationships between data analysis and communication in public life. My work is fed by curiosity, imagination, and a desire to help build local communities and broader systems that support people and their homes while moving beyond extractive frameworks. 

- **Data & Research:** Analyzing social-psychological tactics for increasing civic engagment 
- **Writing:** Exploring social theory, community development, and personal growth on [Substack](https://breyonnajordan.substack.com/).
- **Values:** Collaboration, Adaptability, and Inquiry
